repos.name: thedotmack/claude-mem
repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent –  Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
repos.one_liner: A persistent memory layer that captures, compresses, and injects session context into AI agents.
bullets: Built with TypeScript to provide a middleware layer for LLM session management.
Uses AI-driven summarization to compress historical interactions into actionable context.
Solves the 'context window' problem by injecting relevant past data into future agent sessions.
Ideal for long-term research, complex coding tasks, or maintaining state in agentic workflows.

repos.name: Joooook/12306-mcp
repos.description: This is a 12306 ticket search server based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
repos.one_liner: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for querying 12306 train tickets.
bullets: Implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to bridge LLMs with real-world transit data.
Allows AI agents to natively search for train availability and schedules via natural language.
Demonstrates the power of MCP in integrating legacy infrastructure with modern agentic systems.
Useful for building travel-planning agents or automated booking assistants.

repos.name: CopilotKit/OpenDots
repos.description: Your always-on AI coworkers that move between text, calls, and Slack.
repos.one_liner: A framework for deploying always-on AI coworkers that operate across text, voice, and messaging platforms.
bullets: TypeScript-based architecture designed for cross-platform agentic collaboration.
Enables agents to maintain presence and state across Slack, voice calls, and text interfaces.
Focuses on 'always-on' utility, moving beyond simple chat interfaces to active task execution.
Applicable for enterprise automation, team coordination, and persistent AI-human workflows.

repos.name: QingYunA/answer-me-with-html
repos.description: Answer me with HTML — an agent skill that answers hard questions with a one-page HTML you can actually read. 让 AI Agent 用一页 HTML 回答复杂问题。
repos.one_liner: An agent skill that forces LLMs to output complex answers as structured, readable HTML pages.
bullets: JavaScript-based agent skill designed to improve the readability of LLM-generated data.
Transforms raw text responses into interactive, formatted HTML documents for better information density.
Enhances the utility of AI agents in research and data analysis by providing a visual output layer.
Useful for financial reporting, technical documentation, or summarizing complex datasets.

repos.name: zerx-lab/FluxDown
repos.description: Rust 驱动的多协议下载管理器，支持 HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent 磁力链接及 HLS/DASH 流媒体，智能多线程加速与浏览器无缝集成。精美界面，极致性能，永久免费，零广告。
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, Rust-based multi-protocol download manager with intelligent multi-threading.
bullets: Engineered in Rust for memory safety and extreme performance in data-intensive tasks.
Supports diverse protocols including HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent, and HLS/DASH streaming.
Features intelligent multi-threaded acceleration and seamless browser integration.
Highly relevant for infrastructure-heavy tasks involving large-scale data ingestion or media processing.
